column1: # I1 single-writer allowlist: every production site that may call the legacy audit funnel or a
# mutating method of the projector's SQL layer. Read by single_writer.rs.
# Columns (tab-separated): file, enclosing_fn, callee, count, reason, removed_by.
#   enclosing_fn  the innermost fn containing the call (bare name)
#   callee        the called function or method name
#   count         the exact number of calls to callee inside enclosing_fn
#   removed_by    the order that deletes the site, or `permanent`
# routes-to-runtime: a handle method whose body appends through the runtime rather than writing
# name-collision: a callee that only shares a name with a mutator, such as a gRPC client method.
# The test fails on a site that is not listed, on a count that differs from the code in either
# direction, and on a row whose site no longer exists, so this file only shrinks, deliberately.
# The projector's own modules are listed by function, not by directory.
# Outside the projector: sites a later order removes, or that never write SQL authority (D4)
# Outside the projector: projection, apply and wrapper sites (D-5-1)
# A1: The legacy funnel's own body; it refuses once the library runtime is installed.
# D1: A gRPC client method that only shares a name with a mutator; no SQL is touched.
# P1: Applies a tape-log or typed-rebuild record into SQL.
# P2: A handle or StateHandle method whose body goes through the runtime rather than writing SQL first.
